name: PhoneStamp for WooCommerce
author: phonestamp

sections.description:
PhoneStamp for WooCommerce adds a lightweight digital gift card flow to your store with a direct PhoneStamp bridge. Store owners can create “PhoneStamp Gift Card” products, define pricing via variations, and collect the recipient + sender information that PhoneStamp needs to fulfil the balance.

Highlights

  • Custom PhoneStamp Gift Card product type built on top of WooCommerce variations
  • Recipient, sender, and personal message fields with full sanitization/validation
  • Virtual-only orders so successful payments auto-complete in WooCommerce
  • Danish translation included and ready for additional languages via the .pot file

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/phonestamp directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Create gift card products using the new “PhoneStamp Gift Card” product type
sections.faq:
Do I need a PhoneStamp account?

Yes, you’ll need a PhoneStamp account to fully utilize all features of this plugin.

Are gift cards automatically delivered?

Currently, the plugin handles the WooCommerce integration. Gift card delivery will be handled by PhoneStamp’s system.

Can I customize the gift card email?

Gift card fulfilment is managed from your PhoneStamp account. Update templates or delivery rules directly inside PhoneStamp.

Does it support physical gift cards?

No. PhoneStamp gift cards are always virtual products so they can be delivered digitally without shipping.
